task_instruction: Control this simulated robot with exactly one execute_motion call per request. Use the PsiBot right hand to grasp the brown bottle around its body, keep it upright within 15 degrees, lift it >=0.05 m and hold stably for >=1 second at COM finite-difference speed <=0.05 m/s. Use the supplied current images and any supplied observation groups; fields explicitly omitted by an input condition are unavailable. Choose one or two wrist-relative waypoints with translation norm <=0.15 m, rotation norm <=0.6 rad, duration 0.25–2 seconds. The action interface and static robot description below are fixed across conditions. Select your own wrist path; no complete task program is provided. Physics pauses during inference. Invalid chunks execute nothing and consume a request. task_done executes the final action followed by a one-second hold for independent evaluation; a model claim alone never establishes success. Avoid penetration greater than 0.002 m. Do not request code or other tools. Record observable visual facts and your own concise plan in the two text fields.
